title: Man Thinks He Can Make The Airport His Home, Goes Away In Cuffs
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 22nd, 2024. Airport police were called regarding a man who had been in the airport for days with no flight. When he was asked to leave he refused. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
